trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Investigated**: `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with health checks failing and an error rate of 0.18. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 was older).

2. **Rolled back**: Successfully rolled `checkout-api` back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions — status is now `rolled_out` with v2.3.0 in us-east, us-west, and eu-west.

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy") describing the failure and the rollback. The on-call engineer was paged. (The first attempt was rate-limited; the retry succeeded.)

Note: I did not deploy any new version — the rollback used a previously healthy production release, so no change-manager approval was required.
